entities.name: Afonso I Kongo Reign
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Diogo Cão reaches Kongo 1483; Manikongo Nzinga a Nkuwu baptised as João I 1491; his son Afonso I (Mvemba a Nzinga) embraces Christianity and literacy; diplomatic exchanges with Vatican and Lisbon.
